svg.aria-label: A card-punch press. A reader scans a codebase tile, then a sled slides a card through a punch station one row per round. Five punches fire, three to five questions per round, and each answer becomes a hole. Four gauge pins test the finished card: required sections, edge-case areas, blocking questions and the engineer's own button. When all four agree, a barrier lifts and the card goes to the dock, marked as grilled.
svg.text: exit gate 2/4 · every edge-case area covered
exit gate 3/4 · no blocking question open
